text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is always making food for
me, so I want to return the
favor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In pursuit of that goal, I head to the
shopping mall to scope out my
options.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Fancy meeting you here! Are
you doing some shopping?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was just taking a peek at all the sweet
and savory options here. If I
notice
anything new, I want to give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I had some raspberry macarons!
After I found a spot in the
sitting area, I
gobbled them right up. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But not before I took a picture,
of course. I
have to send something
along with my
review to my parents.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You see,
whenever I find a new tasty treat,
I send them a pic and a
review.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Both my parents work in the culinary
field,
so they really enjoy
reading about my
finds.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm,
that's right! My dad is a chef at an
Italian restaurant, and my
mom is a
patissier.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So even though I loooove cooking, I also
enjoy searching for new
dishes to share
with my parents!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She does seem to be enjoying herself.
Perhaps this is my chance to
repay her with
some good, homemade food.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: WHAT?! You don't need to pay me back for that! I get all the repayment I need watching you eat my food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You always have such a big smile on your
face when you eat my
cooking. That's
more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's a little hard to explain,
but... I can feel
this warm, fuzzy feeling
filling my heart to
the brim when I watch you eat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, seriously, you don't need to worry
about it. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Then how about this? I want to
see you eat my food again,
so come over
for dinner, and I'll make you something!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay! ☆ Time to get shopping! If we want
ingredients, I think the
shopping district is
better than the mall.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I hope you're ready for a real
smorgasbord!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of simmering some chicken
and vegetables in water to
start, but other
than that—

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sumo wrestlers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What?! Where? Where?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the gleeful cries and pointed
fingers of the children, we
both see a
couple of sumo wrestlers on their way back
from practice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, real-life sumo wrestlers! Trainer,
do you think I can go talk to
them?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Right, of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono beams with joy as the sumo
wrestlers turn to meet her
calls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They answer her various questions with
smiles on their faces. I'm sure
Hishi
Akebono's enthusiasm tickles them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really? So that's what you put in your hot
pot...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I see. A nutritious bowl of chanko really is the key to strength.

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you know it! Without that hot pot,
we'd never get this strong!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text: After all, it's food made with feeling. No way you can eat that and not get strong!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I bet whoever's making the hot pot really
wants you to enjoy your
food! I feel the
same way when I cook for others.

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's not just the cook's feelings, you
know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
You can't have a true chanko without
adding feelings from the people
eating
your food! Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A true chanko... The feelings from the
people eating...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I don't get it. How are you
supposed to add the feelings of
the
people eating to a hot pot?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
they're not going to eat it until it's
done, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So how can you add their feelings in...
before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a suspicion that the sumo wrestler
was referring to the
gratitude both sides
feel for each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that's why most meals begin with a
thank-you said before
digging in... The
food just feels incomplete without it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A true chanko... Do you have any ideas,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? How?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hm, maybe that'll give me some kind of
hint...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's do it!
I'm looking forward to a
good meal, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting from the day we met, Hishi
Akebono has served me delicious
meal
after delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I finally have a chance to repay her
with a
meal full of gratitude!
